title: 第十七章 道友来贺建设黄花山第十八章 黄花观供奉斗姆元君
slug: 西游从蜈蚣精到百目真君
content_zh:
雷劫散尽，天光垂落。
黄花山巅那道冲天而起的金光虽然已经收敛。
但地仙诞生时引动的天地灵气震荡。
方圆万里之内，凡是开了灵智的生灵都感应到了那股浩荡的威压。
山林间的走兽匍匐在地，瑟瑟发抖。
水潭中的游鱼沉入潭底，不敢露头。
就连那些平日里占山为王、桀骜不驯的老妖，也都缩在各自的洞府中，大气不敢出一口。
地仙。
这可不是炼虚合道能比的。凡俗四境再厉害，终究是凡。
一旦踏入地仙，便算是真正跨过了仙凡之隔，从此寿元大涨，神通蜕变，是这西牛贺洲群山之中当之无愧的一方霸主。
那些灵智初开的小妖虽然不懂什么大道理。
但本能告诉它们，黄花山那边，出了一位惹不起的大妖。
消息传得比风还快。
黑风洞中，熊罴正扛着一块磨盘大的黑金石在山道上跑得满头大汗。
头顶云层散尽的那一刻，他猛地停下脚步，将黑金石往地上一扔，砸出一个三尺深的坑。
他仰头望向黄花山的方向，咧开大嘴笑了好一阵，随即驾起黑风便往黄花山赶。
半路上又折返回洞，把珍藏多年的几坛蜂蜜酒全扛了出来。
上次吴道友来去匆忙，连酒都没喝上一口，这次非得补上不可。
凌虚洞中，凌虚子正蹲在丹炉前推演一张新的丹方。
地面忽然微微颤动，他抬头看了一眼窗外，放下手中的丹方，捋了捋被炉火熏得焦黄的胡须，瘦削的脸上露出一抹由衷的笑意。

他从木架上取下一只锦盒，盒中装的是他这大半年新炼的一炉凝神丹。
用的是吴耀五毒丹经上的法子改良而来，品质比他之前炼的任何一炉丹都要好。
他将锦盒揣进袖中，出了洞门，驾起一道青灰色的遁光。
盘丝洞中，七个蜘蛛精正在洞中修炼。
红衣女子最先感知到那股气息，猛地睁开眼睛，将几个还在入定的妹妹一一摇醒。
七人凑在洞口往外张望了片刻，确认那股气息确实来自黄花山方向后，洞中顿时响起一片欢呼。
七人翻箱倒柜地收拾了一番。
将洞中最好的灵果蜜饯、最新织好的七彩蛛丝锦缎统统打包带上。
七道彩色遁光从盘丝洞中飞出，齐刷刷地朝黄花山掠去。
吴耀站在山巅，远远便望见了那几道遁光。
黑风山的黑风厚重如山，凌虚洞的青光清瘦如竹。
盘丝洞的七色彩虹娇艳如霞。
从三个不同的方向同时朝黄花山汇聚而来。
他收了护体金光，从山巅走下，在洞府前的平地上站定。
黑风最先落下。
熊罴从黑风中踏出，肩上扛着三坛酒，脚下震得地面都在抖。
他大步走到吴耀面前，上下打量了一番，一掌拍在吴耀肩上，笑声震得山壁上的碎石簌簌往下掉：
“俺就说你肯定能成！地仙！货真价实的地仙！来来来，今天非喝个痛快不可！”
话音未落，青灰色的遁光也落了下来。
凌虚子整了整被风吹乱的道袍，从袖中取出那只锦盒，双手递到吴耀面前：

“贫道没什么好贺的，这一炉凝神丹是按道友丹经上的法子改良的，品质尚可，道友留着用。”
content_en:
The thunderstorm is gone and the sky is falling.
Although the golden light rising into the sky from the top of Huanghua Mountain has subsided.
But the spiritual energy of heaven and earth caused by the birth of the Earth Immortal shook.
Within a radius of tens of thousands of miles, all living beings who have opened their spiritual intelligence can sense the majestic pressure.
The animals in the mountains and forests were lying on the ground, shivering.
The fish in the pool sink to the bottom and dare not show their heads.
Even those unruly old demons who usually dominate the mountains are huddled in their respective caves, not daring to breathe a sigh of relief.
Earthly Immortal.
This is not comparable to Lianxu Hedao. No matter how powerful the four worldly realms are, they are still ordinary.
Once you step into the Earthly Immortal realm, you have truly crossed the line between immortality and mortal life. From then on, your life expectancy will greatly increase, your magical powers will transform, and you will become the well-deserved overlord in the mountains of Xiniuhezhou.
Although those little demons who have just awakened their intelligence don't understand any big principles.
But their instinct told them that there was a big demon on the other side of Huanghua Mountain that they couldn't afford to mess with.
News spreads faster than the wind.
In the Batu Cave, Xiong Zhen was sweating profusely while running along the mountain path carrying a piece of black gold stone as big as a millstone.
The moment the clouds above his head cleared, he suddenly stopped and threw the black gold stone on the ground, making a three-foot-deep pit.
He raised his head and looked in the direction of Huanghua Mountain, grinned widely for a while, and then rode the black wind towards Huanghua Mountain.
On the way, he turned back to the cave and took out all the jars of mead that had been stored for many years.
Fellow Daoist Wu was in such a hurry last time that he didn't even take a sip of wine, so he had to make up for it this time.
In Lingxu Cave, Ling Xuzi was squatting in front of the alchemy furnace to deduce a new elixir recipe.
The ground suddenly trembled slightly. He raised his head and glanced out the window, put down the pill recipe in his hand, stroked his beard that was burnt yellow by the fire, and showed a sincere smile on his thin face.
He took down a brocade box from the wooden shelf. The box contained a new batch of concentration pills that he had refined over the past six months.
It was improved from the method in Wu Yao's Five Poison Pill Sutra, and its quality was better than any other pill he had made before.
He put the brocade box into his sleeve, exited the cave door, and drove up a blue-gray escape light.
In Pansi Cave, seven spider spirits are practicing in the cave.
The woman in red was the first to sense the aura. She opened her eyes suddenly and shook the sisters who were still in trance one by one.
The seven people gathered at the entrance of the cave and looked out for a moment. After confirming that the aura was indeed coming from the direction of Huanghua Mountain, cheers suddenly erupted in the cave.
The seven people rummaged through the boxes and packed them up.
Pack up the best candied spiritual fruit in the cave and the latest colorful spider silk brocade.
Seven colorful rays of light flew out from the Pansi Cave and swept towards Huanghua Mountain.
Wu Yao stood on the top of the mountain and saw those escaping lights from a distance.
The black wind in Heifeng Mountain is as thick as a mountain, and the green light in Lingxu Cave is as thin as bamboo.
The seven-color rainbow in Pansi Cave is as beautiful as the clouds.
They are coming towards Huanghua Mountain from three different directions at the same time.
He took away the protective golden light, walked down from the top of the mountain, and stood on the flat ground in front of the cave.
The black wind fell first.
Xiong Zhen stepped out of the dark wind, carrying three jars of wine on his shoulders, and the ground shook under his feet.
He strode up to Wu Yao, looked him up and down, and slapped Wu Yao on the shoulder. His laughter made the gravel on the mountain wall fall down:
"I said you can definitely make it! Earth Immortal! Real Earth Immortal! Come on, come on, you must have a good drink today!"
Before he finished speaking, the blue-gray escaping light also fell.
Ling Xuzi straightened his Taoist robe that was blown by the wind, took out the brocade box from his sleeve, and handed it to Wu Yao with both hands:
"I have nothing to congratulate you. This furnace of Condensing Pills was improved according to the method in the Taoist Alchemy Sutra. The quality is acceptable. You can keep it for your own use."
